sidebarDescription: Vertical timeline optimized for stacked history items.
notesDescription: This page uses shared timeline mock data and only transforms optional fields for presentation.

notes.order: order switches between newest-first and oldest-first rendering without changing the input data shape.
notes.compact: compact previews the tighter density expected in the ticket detail right sidebar.
notes.optional: markerIcon, badge, description, and meta are toggled without introducing a Service Desk dependency.
notes.empty: Empty-state content is provided by the owning screen while Timeline handles its layout.

career-2016-bkit.title: Started enterprise software development at BKI IT
career-2016-bkit.description: Maintained manufacturing MES platforms and developed in-house MES, asset-management, and data-interface solutions with Java, C# WinForms/WPF, MSSQL, and MariaDB.

career-2019-cynergy.title: Joined Cynergy as a Frontend Developer
career-2019-cynergy.description: Modernized internal ERP and portal workflows for a US-based mobile-device warranty and remanufacturing business, including 18 months onsite in Dallas and continued global remote collaboration.

project-2022-mobileklink.title: Delivered a customer-specific portal workflow for MobileKlink
project-2022-mobileklink.description: Built a single-screen receiving-to-shipping workflow, connected Samsung device logic through Oracle RESTful Services, validated 10 test cases, and completed the initial nine-month plan in eight months.

career-2023-nextjs.title: Modernized legacy ERP and portal screens with React and Next.js
career-2023-nextjs.description: Helped migrate more than 10 Oracle Forms and Java portal screens to React, Next.js, and TypeScript while collaborating through GitHub pull requests and code reviews.

career-2024-helpdesk.title: Led IT Help Desk frontend design and operational stabilization
career-2024-helpdesk.description: Implemented ticket intake, assignment, status, and history workflows alongside responsive cross-browser UI, custom components, Chart.js dashboards, reporting, and production issue response.

portfolio-2025-sunghwan-portal.title: Designed and built Sunghwan Portal
portfolio-2025-sunghwan-portal.description: Turned enterprise Help Desk experience into a production-aligned Service Desk prototype with explicit ticket workflows, role-aware UX, immutable history, LOCAL and REMOTE service boundaries, and PostgreSQL-backed server architecture using Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript.
